intro.title: Twelve rooms. One quiet promise.
intro.body: Wake to the sound of the sea and a morning with no rush, in a twelve-room villa where nothing is excess and nothing is missing. Every corner is cared for so that resting is the only thing you need to do: washed linen, natural light, honest materials and a service that anticipates without intruding. The old town a walk away; the noise, far off.

about.title: An old villa, gently restored
about.body: This old villa was restored with care, keeping the clay of the floors, the lime of the walls and the shade of the garden cypresses. It sits a few steps from the old town, yet a world from its noise: a quiet street, a gate, and calm within. We work with natural materials and local trades, and tend the service so it shows only when needed. Twelve rooms, none alike, all made for staying.

dining.title: Sea, salt and fire
dining.description: Our table celebrates the day's catch and produce from the gardens nearby.

location.directions: 20 minutes from the airport, 5 from the beach and a 10-minute walk to the old town.
